intro.text: The head of King Elhokar's guard on the Shattered Plains, until he was reassigned to Dalinar's army.

items.text: Dalinar assigned Idrin to head the King's Guard, and he was trusted enough to sit in on private meetings. After the Battle of the Tower he grew unhappy guarding the king; he wanted to fight on the Plains and prove that the Kholin army was still strong after Sadeas's betrayal. Dalinar began working Kaladin's men into the guard rotation, and Idrin met Kaladin several times.

Idrin was on duty when Elhokar nearly fell from a balcony whose railing had been weakened in an attempt on his life. The king blamed him, saying it wouldn't have happened with Kaladin on guard, and Idrin left the room in a rage. To calm Elhokar, Dalinar gave Idrin a new post in the army, though privately he didn't think Idrin was at fault and refused to reprimand him.

appearance.text: Darker-skinned than most Alethi, perhaps with Makabaki ancestry, with light green eyes and a full beard. He stands very straight and goes red in the face when angry.

personality.text: Stoic, rarely reacting even to insults, but angered at being called negligent. An excellent commander, loyal to Dalinar and his army.
